entries.question: Do official FAOSTAT Nordic figures exist as single-year (210090) versus only 3-year averages (210091), with uncertainty?
entries.channel: Reuse A3 frozen FAOSTAT ZIP; ItemCodes + Nordic row filter
entries.result: Nordic 210091 present with CI bounds (flag E); Nordic 210090 Value rows = 0
entries.stopReason: Stop rule: do not derive single years from 3-year averages

entries.question: What actual N, sampling, MoE/DE and point estimates appear on open FAO FIES Nordic catalog pages, including any newer than A3?
entries.queryOrDocument: Norway FIES 2023 catalog/2593; 2022 NO/SE/FI data dictionaries
entries.result: Cases visible (800/1002/1001/1000); NOR2023 DE 1.73 MoE 4.1; point estimate/response rate/denominator still absent on open pages
entries.stopReason: No microdata download; country sampling annex PDFs not fetched without needless expansion after Cases/DE captured

entries.question: Are Finnish ISSP 2019 replication data and a newer Social Inequality wave with the meal-skip item available?
entries.channel: FSD Aila FSD3431; ISSP by-year schedule
entries.result: FSD3431 exists with k41c; access class B; guest download blocked; Social Inequality VI planned 2029 only
entries.stopReason: Login/registration not authorized in this package; no newer wave released

entries.question: Do Swedish objective purchase/consumption data link to food insecurity beyond Livsmedelsverket self-report?
entries.channel: SCB Livsmedelsförsäljning landing page + A3 Livsmedelsverket PDF
entries.result: Objective aggregate sales product exists; no FI linkage; Livsmedelsverket remains self-report panel
entries.stopReason: Named channels exhausted for FI-linked objective purchases

entries.question: Is there a validated SIFO–FIES crosswalk or harmonized prevalence matrix?
entries.channel: Web search for SIFO/FIES crosswalk + A3 instrument metadata reuse
entries.queryOrDocument: SIFO FIES crosswalk OR validation Norway OsloMet; A3-O001/O013
entries.result: No Nordic SIFO–FIES validation study found; FAO equating methods are global FIES calibration, not SIFO bridge

entries.question: Is there a repeated Finnish pure multi-item food-access national series (beyond ISSP one-item and StatFin ends-meet)?
entries.channel: THL Sotkanet 4264 metadata; StatFin 132a live re-check; A3 Finnish search reuse
entries.result: 4264 is mixed food/medicine/doctor hardship; StatFin 15 cells re-verified; no FIES/SIFO-like Finnish multi-item series found
entries.stopReason: Further broad Finnish rephrasing stopped per package stop rule
